props.name: slot
props.description:
A slot name for the component. Slots allow the component to receive props from a parent
component. An explicit `null` value indicates that the local props completely override all
props received from a parent.

props.name: style
props.description:
The inline [style](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLElement/style) for the
element.

props.name: suppressHydrationWarning
props.description:
A React-only flag that suppresses the warning React normally logs when an element's
server-rendered content doesn't match the client render during hydration. See [React
docs](https://react.dev/reference/react-dom/client/hydrateRoot#suppressing-unavoidable-hydration-mismatch-errors).

props.name: className
props.description:
The CSS [className](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Element/className) for the
element.

props.name: id
props.description:
The element's unique identifier. See
[MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Global_attributes/id).

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that describes the object.

props.name: aria-details
props.description:
Identifies the element (or elements) that provide a detailed, extended description for the
object.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that labels the current element.

props.name: children
props.description: The children of the component.

props.name: render
props.description:
Overrides the default DOM element with a custom render function.
This allows rendering existing components with built-in styles and behaviors
such as router links, animation libraries, and pre-styled components.

Requirements:

- You must render the expected element type (e.g. if `<button>` is expected, you cannot render an
  `<a>`).
- Only a single root DOM element can be rendered (no fragments).
- You must pass through props and ref to the underlying DOM element, merging with your own prop
  as appropriate.

props.name: selectionMode
props.description: The type of selection that is allowed in the collection.

props.name: disabledKeys
props.description:
The item keys that are disabled. These items cannot be selected, focused, or otherwise
interacted with.

props.name: escapeKeyBehavior
props.description:
Whether pressing the escape key should clear selection in the TagGroup or not.

Most experiences should not modify this option as it eliminates a keyboard user's ability to
easily clear selection. Only use if the escape key is being handled externally or should not
trigger selection clearing contextually.

props.name: shouldSelectOnPressUp
props.description: Whether selection should occur on press up instead of press down.

props.name: disallowEmptySelection
props.description: Whether the collection allows empty selection.

props.name: selectedKeys
props.description: The currently selected keys in the collection (controlled).

props.name: defaultSelectedKeys
props.description: The initial selected keys in the collection (uncontrolled).

props.name: onSelectionChange
props.description: Handler that is called when the selection changes.

props.name: selectionBehavior
props.description: How multiple selection should behave in the collection.

props.name: onAction
props.description:
Handler that is called when a user performs an action on an item. The exact user event depends
on the collection's `selectionBehavior` prop and the interaction modality.

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Handler that is called when a user deletes a tag.

props.name: className
props.description:
The CSS [className](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Element/className) for the
element. A function may be provided to compute the class based on component state.

props.name: renderEmptyState
props.description: Provides content to display when there are no items in the tag list.

props.name: children
props.description: The contents of the collection.

props.name: items
props.description: Item objects in the collection.

props.name: dependencies
props.description: Values that should invalidate the item cache when using dynamic collections.

props.name: href
props.description: A URL to link to. See [MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/a#href).

props.name: hrefLang
props.description:
Hints at the human language of the linked URL.
See[MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/a#hreflang).

props.name: target
props.description:
The target window for the link. See
[MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/a#target).

props.name: rel
props.description:
The relationship between the linked resource and the current page. See
[MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Attributes/rel).

props.name: download
props.description:
Causes the browser to download the linked URL. A string may be provided to suggest a file name.
See [MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/a#download).

props.name: ping
props.description:
A space-separated list of URLs to ping when the link is followed. See
[MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/a#ping).

props.name: referrerPolicy
props.description:
How much of the referrer to send when following the link. See
[MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/a#referrerpolicy).

props.name: routerOptions
props.description: Options for the configured client side router.

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Handler that is called when the element loses focus.

props.name: onFocusChange
props.description: Handler that is called when the element's focus status changes.

props.name: onPress
props.description: Handler that is called when the press is released over the target.

props.name: onPressStart
props.description: Handler that is called when a press interaction starts.

props.name: onPressEnd
props.description:
Handler that is called when a press interaction ends, either
over the target or when the pointer leaves the target.

props.name: onPressChange
props.description: Handler that is called when the press state changes.

props.name: onPressUp
props.description:
Handler that is called when a press is released over the target, regardless of
whether it started on the target or not.

props.name: onClick
props.description:

provided for compatibility with other libraries. `onPress` provides
additional event details for non-mouse interactions.

props.name: excludeFromTabOrder
props.description:
Whether to exclude the element from the sequential tab order. If true,
the element will not be focusable via the keyboard by tabbing. This should
be avoided except in rare scenarios where an alternative means of accessing
the element or its functionality via the keyboard is available.

props.name: preventFocusOnPress
props.description:
Whether to prevent focus from moving to the button when pressing it.

Caution, this can make the button inaccessible and should only be used when alternative
keyboard interaction is provided, such as ComboBox's MenuTrigger or a NumberField's
increment/decrement control.
